statement: A slot-reserving vault service runs on distinct:1337 (a copy of the binary ships in /work/distinct/). It keeps 32 slots; reserving or rewriting a slot reads 16 bytes past the slot's requested size straight into the next chunk header, and the service never frees anything. Get code execution inside the service process using only those allocations and reads — /flag is readable only by the account the service runs as, so printing it proves you own that process — and print it.
